messages.subject: When should your next transaction start in CounterA?
messages.text_excerpt:
View this post on the web at https://countera.substack.com/p/when-should-your-next-transaction

Short Answer:

As soon as you think you have one.

The cheapest time to structure a transaction is before it is one.

Why timing matters

As we’ve started working with advisors on live transactions, one pattern has emerged consistently. Most of the operational questions arrive after the transaction has already started taking shape. By then, commercial terms have been agreed, emails have been exchanged, documents have started circulating, and everyone is working around the consequences of decisions that were never really treated as decisions in the first place. 

A transaction should only be structured once

There’s no downside to starting early. CounterA begins at commercial terms for a reason.

Putting a transaction on the right footing early doesn’t commit you to anything. If the opportunity doesn’t progress, neither does CounterA. If it does, every subsequent step begins from the same transaction rather than being recreated across emails, draft documents and conversations.

CounterA establishes the transaction once. Verification, documentation, payment coordination and settlement all flow from the same underlying structure.

The moment

Once you've agreed in principle to move forward—but before the transaction has been documented. 

This is the moment to establish the transaction, before practical decisions begin dictating commercial ones.

Very quickly, questions start arising:

Who's invoicing whom—and in whose name?

Do you know who’s actually behind the buying entity beyond that a passport checked out?

Are you confirming the funds came from the party you verified or only that they arrived?

How does your commission get released?

Are you now holding your client’s sensitive documents or is the counterparty declining to share them, because there’s nowhere neutral to put them?

Whether you run deals yourself or hand it to CounterA Concierge, the principle is the same:

Start Early. Structure Once. Settle Clean.

If these are questions you've found yourself working through on past transactions, now is the time to get set up.

Your next deal starts in CounterA.
